tools.name: unit_economics
tools.description: Calculates customer acquisition cost (CAC), customer lifetime value (LTV), the LTV to CAC ratio and CAC payback in months from spend, new customers, revenue per customer, gross margin and churn.

tools.name: growth_rate
tools.description: Calculates total growth and compound growth per period between a start and end value, for example month on month, quarter on quarter or year on year (CAGR).

tools.name: roas_check
tools.description: Calculates return on ad spend from ad revenue and ad spend, and the break-even ROAS implied by gross margin, then says whether the campaign covers its product cost.

tools.name: ad_budget_planner
tools.description: Estimates the monthly ad budget needed to reach a target number of new customers from cost per click, landing page conversion rate and lead to customer rate.

tools.name: find_growth_moves
tools.description: Returns documented 2026 growth moves by Indian companies from upGrowth's Growth Moves research (January to September 2026), filtered by sector, company or keyword. Each move includes the leader, date and a link to the original source.

tools.name: max_affordable_cac
tools.description: Works back from customer lifetime value to the most a business can pay to acquire a customer (and, optionally, a lead) while keeping a target LTV to CAC ratio, 3:1 by default.

tools.name: period_change
tools.description: Calculates the simple percentage change between 2 values, such as year over year (YoY), month over month (MoM), quarter over quarter or week over week, including sales or revenue growth and percentage increase or decrease.

tools.name: seo_roi
tools.description: Estimates the monthly return on an SEO investment from extra organic visits, conversion rate, value per conversion and monthly SEO cost, plus the break-even traffic gain.

tools.name: ai_crawler_access_check
tools.description: Reads a website's public robots.txt and llms.txt and reports whether AI crawlers from OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity and Google (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended and others) are allowed, restricted or blocked.

tools.name: mdr_charges
tools.description: Calculates merchant discount rate (MDR) charges on card or payment gateway sales: the MDR fee, GST on that fee, total cost, effective rate and net settlement. Uses the MDR % the user gives; it does not look up provider rates.

tools.name: robots_txt_generator
tools.description: Writes a robots.txt file that allows or blocks AI crawlers by purpose: model training (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended), AI search (OAI-SearchBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot) and user-triggered fetches (ChatGPT-User, Claude-User, Perplexity-User), plus paths to keep private and a sitemap. Checks the properties Google lists as required for that type (per Google Search Central structured data docs, developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/structured-da

tools.name: content_seo_check
tools.description: Analyses text the user pastes: word, sentence and paragraph counts, reading time, approximate Flesch reading ease, long sentences and paragraphs, headings found, and focus keyword count, density and placement. Counts exactly, which assistants often get wrong.

tools.name: meta_tags_builder
tools.description: Builds the HTML head tags for a page: title, meta description, canonical, Open Graph and Twitter card tags, with character counts and truncation warnings.

tools.name: youtube_earnings
tools.description: Estimates YouTube ad earnings from monthly views and the RPM from YouTube Studio (or CPM, monetized playback % and the 55% long-form creator share), plus watch hours against the YouTube Partner Program threshold.

tools.name: instagram_earnings
tools.description: Estimates monthly and yearly Instagram brand-deal income from the rates the user charges per post, per story or per 1,000 followers, and the cost per engagement a brand pays.

tools.name: engagement_rate
tools.description: Calculates social media engagement rate for Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn or any platform from likes, comments, shares and saves, by followers, reach, impressions or views.

tools.name: website_ad_revenue
tools.description: Estimates display ad revenue for a website or blog from monthly pageviews and page RPM, or from ad impressions per page, CPM and fill rate.

tools.name: ytd_growth
tools.description: Compares year-to-date totals with the same period last year, from monthly values or YTD totals, and gives a simple full-year run rate.

tools.name: ppc_forecast
tools.description: Forecasts a paid search or social budget: clicks, conversions, cost per acquisition, revenue, ROAS, profit after ad spend and break-even CPA, from budget, CPC and conversion rate.

tools.name: customer_lifetime_value
tools.description: Calculates customer lifetime value for repeat-purchase businesses such as D2C and ecommerce from average order value, purchases per year, lifespan and margin, with optional discounting and LTV to CAC.

tools.name: ecommerce_metrics
tools.description: Calculates average order value, conversion rate, revenue per visitor and orders per customer, and the sessions needed to hit a revenue target.

tools.name: growth_projection
tools.description: Projects a value forward at a compound growth rate per period (exponential growth), shows each period, the doubling time and how long it takes to reach a target.

tools.name: acos_check
tools.description: Calculates Amazon advertising cost of sales (ACoS), ROAS, break-even ACoS from margin, profit after ads, and TACoS against total sales.

tools.name: share_of_voice
tools.description: Calculates share of voice for a brand against competitors on any metric: AI assistant citations or mentions, search impressions, ad impressions, social mentions or press coverage.

tools.name: break_even
tools.description: Calculates break-even units and revenue from fixed costs, price and variable cost per unit, the contribution margin, and units needed for a target profit.

tools.name: campaign_roi
tools.description: Calculates ROI for a marketing campaign or channel (content, email, events, influencer, recruitment marketing) on revenue and on gross profit.

tools.name: attrition_rate
tools.description: Calculates employee attrition or customer churn rate for a period from separations and headcount at the start and end, with a simple annualised rate.

tools.name: book_strategy_call
tools.description: Returns the link to book a free 30-minute growth strategy call with upGrowth. Use only when the user asks to speak with upGrowth.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: schema_generator, meta_tags_builder · Private data: robots_txt_generator · Public sink: schema_generator, youtube_earnings, instagram_earnings, growth_projection, share_of_voice, campaign_roi · Destructive: ytd_growth.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: schema_generator, meta_tags_builder · Private data: robots_txt_generator · Public sink: schema_generator, youtube_earnings, instagram_earnings, growth_projection, share_of_voice, campaign_roi · Destructive: ytd_growth

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
